# Manage specification changes through the tool

Specification graph changes are managed by the command-line tool rather than by
manual editing of canonical files. The user-facing editor uses that managed
editing workflow rather than a separate file-writing mechanism.

Origin: [INTENTION_SPEC.md](../INTENTION_SPEC.md), tool-managed changes.
